plugins.name: Proxmox VE
plugins.description: Scoped Proxmox node, LXC, storage, task, and backup access.

plugins.name: Synology DSM
plugins.description: Read-only DSM system resources, storage capacity, and health summaries.

permission_descriptions.storage.read: Read storage pool, volume, capacity, and aggregate disk health.
permission_descriptions.system.read: Read DSM system health and bounded resource utilization.

plugins.name: UniFi Network
plugins.description: Official local API access for configuration, diagnostics, connected clients, and firewall policy logging.

permission_descriptions.clients.read: Read current connection and access context for a specific connected client.
permission_descriptions.config.read: Read bounded network and WiFi configuration summaries without credentials or WiFi keys.
permission_descriptions.diagnostics.read: Read device state and resource health with bounded diagnostic findings.
permission_descriptions.firewall.rules: Read firewall policy summaries; at Write level, change only one policy's syslog logging state.
